summary: Meta ships no switch to remove Meta AI from WhatsApp. You can now hide the blue circle button (Settings → Chats → Show Meta AI Button, rolling out in phases), and Advanced Chat Privacy blocks @Meta AI in specific chats. But the assistant itself stays in the app — there is no way to turn it off.

steps.path: There is no disable option. Mitigations only: never tap the Meta AI circle, archive/mute the Meta AI chat, and avoid @-mentioning it in group chats.
Hide the button (phased rollout, not all users have it yet): Settings → Chats → toggle off "Show Meta AI Button". This removes the blue circle from the chat list but does not disable Meta AI.
Block AI in specific chats: open the chat → tap name at top → Advanced Chat Privacy → toggle on. Prevents @Meta AI usage in that conversation. Per-chat, not global.
Gemini/assistant integrations are separate: in the Gemini app → profile → Apps → turn off the WhatsApp connection (this only stops Gemini, not Meta AI).

regionNotes: EU rollout arrived later and with more disclosure requirements, but still without a user-facing off switch.
whyTheyDidIt: Meta AI's usage numbers come from being placed inside apps with billions of daily users — an off switch would collapse them.
